base_package.verification: reconstructed from main updater chunks; SHA-256, byte count, and ZIP integrity verified

purpose: Extend the verified published v0.3.57 payload's shared logical-entry capture to record RCX, RDX, and raw [RDX+0x10] together, preserve the entry snapshot through recursive calls, and correlate it with the exact root descriptor. The published payload embeds probe 0.3.35, so the patch also carries forward the shared-entry capture introduced by the 0.3.36 lane patch.

capture_design.method: single shared logical-entry hook; captures the first two x64 arguments and the entry-time raw [RDX+0x10] value; preserves caller RVA and descriptor correlation through verified self-recursion
capture_design.caller_coverage: all runtime callers entering the shared hook; retains the 52-static-candidate count; no per-caller breakpoints
capture_design.timing_limit: callee-entry snapshot immediately after call, not a pre-instruction breakpoint snapshot; the later root-add sample remains separate

interpretation.measured: The main updater's v0.3.57 manifest points to a 389848-byte ZIP with SHA-256 eb8fbc66c20f6dd976018d35fc89aac11023360e5dc3f40c0164be7452fd2126. Reconstructed bytes pass hash/size and ZIP integrity checks. The embedded probe reports 0.3.35. The separate local source ZIP was 398312 bytes with SHA-256 a29c4863f9321dce98fa5e07c5178fce433d4d212debdd402730ffa48541e4c5 and is not the published package.
interpretation.inference: The verified updater payload is the correct patch base; the patch bundles the prior shared-entry capture so it reaches the requested 0.3.37 instrumentation from published probe 0.3.35.
interpretation.hypothesis: The call-entry RCX/RDX values preserve the relevant dispatch arguments; validate with a live probe 0.3.37 event before assigning semantic meaning to the slot.

steps: After Main integration publishes Surveyor 0.3.58 / probe 0.3.37, open Surveyor → GitHub / updates → Check for updates and install 0.3.58.
Restart Surveyor; fully exit NMS, then launch NMS from Surveyor so probe 0.3.37 loads at process start.
Enter any accessible derelict only until the root event is captured; no full traversal is needed.
Close NMS and upload the captured root event or all saved evidence.
Tell Runtime-A to check; correlate RCX, RDX, and [RDX+0x10] with the same root descriptor and caller RVA.
human_validation.success_condition: A fresh probe 0.3.37 artifact contains non-null or explicitly failed RCX, RDX, and [RDX+0x10] fields at shared entry, with caller RVA and matching root descriptor; later root-add value remains separately labeled.

rollback: Use Surveyor rollback or reinstall v0.3.57.
Fully exit and restart NMS to reload the published payload's probe 0.3.35.
No saved-evidence migration is required; the new fields are additive.
